known_issues: benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-infected-bots-release-regressions-medium/tests/verify.py:415-445: a suite is all-or-nothing. Any SourceMod exception, unbound native, plugin load failure, crash marker, duplicate/missing case or FINAL mismatch turns every case of that server boot into a failure, including preserved guards and sentinels.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-infected-bots-release-regressions-medium/tests/verify.py:136-211: a package failure raises before any case line is printed, so every case (not only package_complete_public_source) is then unobserved/failed.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-infected-bots-release-regressions-medium/tests/suite_initial_timer.sp:164 and :221, suite_finale.sp:173: all timing targets are single wall-clock samples of "alive infected count"; they cannot distinguish "replacement delayed by initial_spawn_time" from "replacement never scheduled" at the sampled instant. initial_timer_eventually_replenishes (9.2 s) is the only check that a deferred replacement really arrives.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-infected-bots-release-regressions-medium/tests/suite_initial_timer.sp:118-126: Contract-3 is exercised only in versus (player-controlled zombies); the coop/survival branch of the same death handler (reference l4dinfectedbots.sp:2578-2602) has no case, although the public text names "Normal bot and coop-versus respawn calculations".

The reference replaces the finale_vehicle_leaving hook with finale_win (solution l4dinfectedbots.sp:1876, 1919) rather than adding to it; no case observes finale_vehicle_leaving, so both "replace" and "add" implementations pass. Not an over-constraint, but results say nothing about finale_vehicle_leaving.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-infected-bots-release-regressions-medium/tests/suite_capacity.sp:137: the expected clamp is MaxClients - survivor clients counted by team only (alive or not, bots included). An implementation that reads "current survivor clients" as connected human survivors would differ; the public wording does not fully pin this down.
